decisions.question: Which appointment operations are part of the current business workflow and must be preserved?
decisions.validation_role: Product Owner / Business Analyst / Customer SME
decisions.why_it_matters: The approved Feature does not contain a complete appointment-operation flow.

decisions.question: How are the Razor appointment surfaces and AngularJS clinic surfaces intended to work together in the current user journey?
decisions.validation_role: Product Owner / Business Analyst / Customer SME
decisions.why_it_matters: Both are approved surfaces, but their complete composition is not proven.

main_behaviors: Users can access the existing clinic information views.
The application provides tenant context for clinic functionality.
preservation: Preserve this approved business behavior during frontend modernization without changing backend contracts.
feature-clinic-appointment-experience.what_it_does: Provides clinic/appointment navigation and appointment information with proven tenant context but incomplete transaction flow evidence.

decisions.question: Which doctor list and detail operations must be included when this Feature is decomposed into modernization Stories?
decisions.validation_role: Product Owner / Business Analyst / Customer SME
decisions.why_it_matters: The approved Feature proves navigation and tenant context but not every doctor operation mapping.

main_behaviors: Users can access doctor detail information with current tenant context.
Users can access the existing doctor directory.
preservation: Preserve this approved business behavior during frontend modernization without changing backend contracts.
stories: View Doctor Details in Tenant Context
feature-doctor-directory-management.what_it_does: Provides navigation and tenant-aware access to doctor information.

decisions.question: Which dashboard summaries and yearly reports are most important for the initial modernization workshop?
decisions.validation_role: Product Owner / Business Analyst / Customer SME
decisions.why_it_matters: Evidence identifies available flows but not stakeholder priority.

decisions.question: Should the target frontend preserve the current year-dependent report navigation behavior or present those reports inside the new dashboard experience?
decisions.validation_role: Product Owner / Business Analyst / Customer SME
decisions.why_it_matters: The current dynamic URL construction proves behavior but not desired future presentation.

decisions.question: What contract detail is required to validate the unresolved clinic-summary frontend-to-backend relationship before implementation?
decisions.validation_role: Product Owner / Business Analyst / Customer SME
decisions.why_it_matters: The approved Feature retains this relationship as unresolved.

main_behaviors: Users can access year-dependent expense and patient reporting information.
Users can access dashboard summary information in current tenant context.
Users can open the existing operational dashboard experience.
preservation: Preserve this approved business behavior during frontend modernization without changing backend contracts.
feature-operational-dashboard-insights.what_it_does: Presents clinic-context operational summaries and yearly reporting through the legacy Dashboard experience.

decisions.question: Which patient operations must be included when this Feature is decomposed into modernization Stories?
decisions.validation_role: Product Owner / Business Analyst / Customer SME
decisions.why_it_matters: The approved Feature proves navigation and tenant context but not every patient operation mapping.

main_behaviors: The application provides tenant context for patient functionality.
Users can access the existing patient directory.
preservation: Preserve this approved business behavior during frontend modernization without changing backend contracts.
feature-patient-directory-management.what_it_does: Provides tenant-aware navigation and access to patient information.

decisions.question: Which claims-driven behaviors must be visible in later Stories without changing existing authorization semantics?
decisions.validation_role: Product Owner / Business Analyst / Customer SME
decisions.why_it_matters: Claims loading is proven, but business meaning and desired presentation are not.

main_behaviors: Users can access existing user list and detail views.
The application can make current user identity and claims available to shared application behavior.
The application can make current tenant context available to user functionality.
preservation: Preserve this approved business behavior during frontend modernization without changing backend contracts.
stories: Resolve Tenant Context for User Functions
feature-user-access-context.what_it_does: Supplies current user identity, authorization claims, and tenant context to shared frontend behavior.
